messages:
Maya: Heads-up — during the quant-8x4 bring-up (model v2-quant) our benchmark run showed a quality regression on low-frequency intents, especially `billing_cancellation` and `refund_flow`. Embedding recall down ~6% vs fp16 baseline and we see a handful of hallucinations. Repro command below. Marking rollback on the rollout until we curate a targeted golden set.

Tony: Got it. Can you paste the failing eval job / metrics?

Maya: Eval link: https://internal.redwood/evals/runner/2345 (note: internal only). Quick reproduce: 
```
python -m evals.run --model redwood/v2-quant --promptset promptset_A --max-tokens 256 --batch 64 --seed 42 --out results/v2-quant-repro.json
```
Outputs show recall drop and higher false-positive hallucination rate on those intents.

Elena: Is the failure concentrated in a single traffic slice or spread? If it's sparse we should sample a targeted 500 examples from last 30d filtered by those intents and then dedupe aggressively.

Maya: Mostly sparse — concentrated on older utterance phrasing. Agree with targeted sample + dedupe + golden review.

Ashwin: Proposed sample pipeline (I can run):
```
python tools/sample.py \
  --source traffic-logs \
  --days 30 \
  --intents billing_cancellation,refund_flow \
  --count 500 \
  --dedupe-threshold 0.92 \
  --min-tokens 5 \
  --out s3://redwood-curation/quant8x4/2112345678-target.jsonl
```
Will also compute fingerprint and embed for near-dup clustering.

Maya: Perfect. After dedupe we need a human-reviewed golden subset of ~100 examples (70 eval, 30 QA). Reviewers: @Elena + @Ashwin for golden QA. Labelers: Sam, Ria, Nate for initial labeling. Deadline EOD tomorrow to keep rollback window small.

Tony: I'll kick the sampling job in ~15m and set a short TTL for the sample.

LabelerBot: Assigned label task `curation/quant8x4/2112345678` to Sam, Ria, Nate. Instructions: follow curation guide, flag ambiguous cases, mark duplicates with tag `near-dup`. Estimated throughput 60/hr each.

Sam (labeler): On it. Will prioritize `billing_cancellation` subtype examples first.

Elena: I'll take the first 50 golden review passes tonight, Ashwin you take the rest tomorrow?

Ashwin: Yep — will do 50 tomorrow AM. Also adding a lightweight smoke eval to CI gate: add `quant8x4-targeted` to the eval matrix so pre-rollout runs it. Example snippet to add to our matrix: 
```
- name: quant8x4-targeted
  model: redwood/v2-quant
  promptset: s3://redwood-curation/quant8x4/2112345678-golden-70.jsonl
  thresholds:
    recall: 0.92
    hallucination_rate: 0.03
```

Tony: Sample job finished and uploaded: s3://redwood-curation/quant8x4/2112345678-target.jsonl. Pushed curation tag `curation/quant8x4/2026-03-20`.

ops-bot: [monitoring] Detected spike in LM latency during the initial quant rollout window — automated rollback triggered (no customer impact).

Maya: Thanks — holding rollout until golden passes. Once golden 70 eval meets thresholds we'll can re-enable canary with 10% traffic and extra tracing.

Elena: Quick note: remember to run fingerprint-based dedupe + manual check for paraphrase clusters. I found a cluster of ~12 paraphrases that were not filtered at 0.92; bumped threshold to 0.95 for final golden generation.

Ashwin: Updated pipeline: dedupe 0.95 for golden, cluster size cap 5, and ensure stratified sampling across sub-intents. Will regenerate golden and notify labelers shortly.

Maya: Appreciate the fast turnaround. I'll update the rollout ticket and pause the promote job.

Tony: Leaving a short command here for anyone who needs to regenerate sample locally: 
`./scripts/generate_targeted_sample.sh --intents billing_cancellation,refund_flow --days 30 --count 500`

Maya: Follow-ups: (1) create a small eval dashboard tile for the golden to track regressions over time, (2) add this golden to the model onboarding checklist, (3) post a short postmortem if we find the regression tied to quant kernel selection.

Sam (labeler): Golden labeling started, reporting ambiguous examples to #eng-ml for quick clarifications.

Maya: Closing loop here — thanks everyone. Will reopen rollout when golden passes and CI smoke is green.
